svg.title: Three Panels: Yellow, Orange, Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Three photographed separate panels, approximate frontal proportions and spacing. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of orange, yellow; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.nga.gov/artworks/107336; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
